info.title: Allscreenshots Universal API
info.description: Capture website screenshots, run bulk jobs, and manage recurring captures

post.description: Creates a new async screenshot job in Allscreenshots.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: The webpage URL to capture asynchronously.

format.description: Output format such as png, jpeg, webp, or pdf.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of the visible viewport.

response_type.description: How the finished job result should be returned.

webhook_url.description: Optional URL to notify when the async job completes.

webhook_secret.description: Optional secret used to sign webhook deliveries.
